description:
A confirmation dialog for dangerous or irreversible actions.
Supports simple confirmation or input-match confirmation where the user
must type a specific value (e.g., project name) to proceed.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element that opens the dialog.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the user confirms the action.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Use destructive styling for dangerous actions.

props.name: confirmValue
props.description: If set, the user must type this exact value to confirm (e.g., project name).

props.name: confirmHint
props.description: Hint text shown above the confirmation input (e.g., "Type the project name to confirm").

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the confirm action is loading.
